slides.say: Error Boundaries only catch errors during rendering of their children. Some errors slip past.

slides.text: Not caught: event handlers, server rendering, the boundary’s own errors, async code like setTimeout.
slides.say: They do not catch errors in event handlers, during server side rendering, in the boundary itself, or in async code like set timeout.
For event handlers, use try and catch, and keep the error in state if you need to show it.

slides.text: Exception: errors inside useTransition’s startTransition ARE caught.
slides.say: One exception: errors thrown inside the start transition function from use transition are caught by Error Boundaries.
